method.purpose: Separate literal state-label agreement from the primary full exact-source parser score.
method.rule: Find canonical LABEL:STATE strings at start or after a pipe, followed by '[' or a pipe or end of text. A field is available only with exactly one recognized occurrence; zero or multiple occurrences are unavailable and incorrect.
method.denominator: All 120 gold fields in all 24 cases per run; unavailable labels remain in the denominator. No case or field is excluded.
method.payload_policy: Payloads are ignored. No bracket, slot, span, source, referent, temporal, evidence, or clinical validity is checked or claimed. A pipe within malformed payload text can act as a label boundary. Canonical label order does not establish valid output syntax.
method.interpretation: This is literal label agreement, not standalone validated semantic-state accuracy, grounded extraction, complete evidence accuracy, or useful note yield.
method.primary_rule: The preplanned primary score marks all fields incorrect when the full raw exact-source parser fails; this diagnostic does not change that rule or any primary artifact.
method.limitations: Posthoc on a small synthetic development set with agent-applied annotations; not clinical, human, or confirmatory validation. Unlabeled state tokens are not inferred or repaired.
method.reproduction: Standard library only; no model calls or product imports. Completed provenance and source/gold hashes are verified before output analysis. Use --output - for a read-only reproduction.
